evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Establish and enforce data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data governance, HIPAA compliance, data quality, validation, and reconciliation dominate throughout with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: Support data governance frameworks and compliance with institutional policies
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Healthcare financial reporting (physician productivity, reimbursement, compensation) with explicit HIPAA and institutional compliance language pushes this to high domain risk.

evidence.data_team_maturity: designs, develops, and maintains enterprise financial data infrastructure and analytics solutions for the School of Medicine
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role is building a centralized financial data warehouse from scratch, integrating multiple disparate enterprise systems (PeopleSoft, HR, CPMP, SOMDASH) — an establish-the-foundation signal despite the institutional setting.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and implement a centralized financial data warehouse integrating PeopleSoft, HR, CPMP, Report Center, SOMDASH, and external data sources
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific named enterprise systems, methodologies (dimensional modeling, star schema, wRVUs, funds flow), and precise scope show exactly what the role involves day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: developing predicative and descriptive analytics, and delivering executive-level dashboards... support institutional financial strategy
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly built around financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and institutional financial strategy for the School of Medicine.
evidence.autonomy_level: The incumbent operates under general direction and exercises significant independent judgement in architecting scalable, secure, and high-performance analytic solutions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Explicit independent-judgment and architecting language for institutional financial strategy shows the role sets direction, not just executes scoped tasks.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI assisted analytic platforms are mentioned only as a preferred-qualification nice-to-have ('AI assisted analytic platforms or features within tools such as Tableau Power BI or Excel'), a vague interest signal rather than a required candidate skill.
evidence.testing_framing: Establish and enforce data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality, validation, and reconciliation are named as an owned responsibility with action verbs ('establish and enforce'), not just a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Knowledge of data governance, HIPPA, and secure data architecture practices
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High — HIPAA compliance, data governance, and institutional policy compliance appear repeatedly and are framed as core to the role, alongside 'protecting institutional data and privacy' in the role summary.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: designs, develops, and maintains enterprise financial data infrastructure and analytics solutions for the School of Medicine
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role is explicitly building a new centralized financial data warehouse and integration architecture from disparate existing systems — a clear greenfield signal.
evidence.loss_aversion: Knowledge of data governance, HIPPA, and secure data architecture practices — reflects strong regulatory/compliance risk framing appropriate to healthcare financial data.
